blocks.html:
The interface an Audit Module provider implements. A provider stores audit
logs and reads them back. It never updates or deletes a single audit log.

Every provider must have a static `identifier` property.

Stores a batch of audit logs. The Audit Module buffers recorded audit logs
and calls this method with up to `buffer.max_size` of them at a time. The
audit logs already have their ID and dates set.

Throw when the batch can't be stored: the module retries a few times
before it drops the batch, so the write should be safe to repeat.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the audit log, prefixed with `audlog_`.

children.name: started_at
children.description: When the action started, such as when the request arrived.

children.name: ended_at
children.description: When the action ended, such as when the response was sent.

children.name: actor_type
children.description: The type of actor that performed the action.

children.name: actor_id
children.description: The ID of the user, API key, or customer that performed the action.

children.name: impersonator_id
children.description: The ID of the Medusa staff member acting as the actor, on Medusa Cloud.

children.name: action
children.description: The name of the action, such as `order.cancel` or `POST /admin/orders/:id/cancel`.

children.name: resource_type
children.description: The type of resource acted on, such as `order`.

children.name: resource_id
children.description: The ID of the resource acted on. `null` when the action acts on several resources.

children.name: outcome
children.description: How the action ended.

children.name: request
children.description: The HTTP details. `null` for an audit log written outside an API request.

children.name: method
children.description: The HTTP method, such as `POST`.

children.name: route
children.description: The route pattern, such as `/admin/orders/:id/cancel`.

children.name: path
children.description: The request path without the query string.

children.name: status_code
children.description: The response status code.

children.name: request_id
children.description: The request ID, the same one that appears in the application logs.

children.name: ip_address
children.description: The client IP address.

children.name: user_agent
children.description: The client user agent.

children.name: request_data
children.description: The request fields that the route chose to keep.

children.name: response_data
children.description: The response fields that the route chose to keep.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Any other data attached to the audit log.

types.name: Promise
types.description: Resolves when the batch is stored.
